title: Prairie Avenue runs straight across 18th Street
items: North of Glessner, Prairie Avenue no longer steps west at 18th Street. Both 1911 atlas sheets draw it straight, so the 16th-18th sheet is now joined to the Glessner sheet at the crossing they share.
Curbs, walks, lots, parkway trees, 54 houses and the lakefront tracks on that sheet moved with it, about 1.1 m east and 1.4 m north.
The thin light line running up the roadway between 16th and 18th Streets is gone.
